page_title: Rajendra Prasad N | Lead AWS DevOps Engineer
headline: Lead AWS DevOps Engineer | Infrastructure, Security & Integration
summary_html: Lead AWS DevOps Engineer with 10 years of overall IT experience spanning build and release engineering, enterprise cloud infrastructure, automation, and production operations. Delivers AWS infrastructure, Terraform and CloudFormation automation, secure CI/CD, and application integration across multiple environments. Combines VPC networking, IAM controls, Secrets Manager, EC2, managed databases, and EKS with Python/Bash tooling, observability, incident response, and recovery planning. Leads cross-team release coordination, technical coaching, and operational documentation.

achievements.text: Delivered VPC networking, private service connectivity, identity controls, and repeatable Terraform/CloudFormation provisioning for enterprise workloads.
Built Python FastAPI integrations for delivery tooling and supported microservices, database connectivity, certificates, and environment readiness.
Standardized CI/CD controls, coordinated production releases, and implemented monitoring, backup, and disaster-recovery capabilities.

experience.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
impact: Implemented secure service connectivity using AWS PrivateLink, VPC endpoints, and private networking controls to protect sensitive application traffic.
Automated provisioning of Databricks environments on AWS across isolated accounts, standardizing network integration, IAM controls, and environment consistency.
Architected and maintained scalable CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, GitHub, and reusable deployment workflows to automate build, test, and release execution.

Established Git branching, approval, and artifact versioning standards and integrated DevSecOps controls into release workflows through secure secrets handling, Terraform validation, and pre-deployment policy checks across AWS environments.
Automated platform operations with Python, Bash, and PowerShell to reduce manual effort and accelerate provisioning, support, and recovery workflows.
Supported Java and Node.js microservices on AWS, improving scalability, runtime stability, and production readiness for cloud-native applications.
Directed end-to-end release management across multiple engineering teams by aligning schedules, dependencies, change windows, and risk mitigation plans.
Coordinated incident response and production release support, minimizing downtime and accelerating service restoration during high-priority events.
Authored technical documentation, deployment guides, and operational runbooks to improve knowledge transfer and support readiness.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
impact: Implemented GitLab CI best practices, including reusable templates, pipeline governance, and controlled branch-based execution.

Improved Kubernetes release processes by standardizing deployment patterns, secure runner standards, controlled branch protections, container image validation, and pipeline checks across environments.
Troubleshot pipeline, container, and Kubernetes issues in partnership with development teams to accelerate delivery and reduce deployment failures.
Enforced SCM best practices and coached development teams on GitLab workflows, branch governance, and merge standards.
Deployed and administered self-hosted and auto-scaling build agents for Linux and Windows workloads to support high-throughput CI/CD operations.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer II
impact: Designed secure VPC networking, Route 53 DNS, security groups, load balancing, VPN connectivity, Direct Connect, and traffic-routing patterns for enterprise workloads.
Provisioned AWS infrastructure using CloudFormation, Terraform, and pipeline-driven infrastructure-as-code deployment patterns.
Implemented disaster recovery, backup, and observability controls using AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery, AWS Backup, and Amazon CloudWatch.
Implemented GitHub Actions workflows for deploying services to Kubernetes clusters across multiple environments.
Troubleshot build and release pipeline failures and resolved deployment issues across distributed engineering teams.
Published versioned artifacts to enterprise repositories and package managers to support downstream engineering consumption and traceability.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Senior SRE
impact: Authored and enforced custom policy controls aligned to internal security and governance requirements across AWS accounts.
Implemented MFA, identity access controls, and role-based access management for users and groups across cloud environments.
Developed internal APIs in Python FastAPI to integrate Jenkins, Jira, and JFrog processes with platform automation.
Developed custom Prometheus exporters in Python to capture application-specific operational metrics for SRE use cases.
Built resilient Ansible roles and playbooks to deploy highly available Grafana, Prometheus, and Node Exporter monitoring stacks.
Administered CloudBees Jenkins, JFrog Artifactory, and Xray enterprise tooling for secure software delivery.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
impact: Worked extensively with AWS infrastructure services including EC2, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, and managed database platforms for enterprise workloads.
Automated fleet-level configuration enforcement for Linux and Windows EC2 instances and managed secure access and database connectivity in line with enterprise security standards.
Supported enterprise applications on AWS by troubleshooting CloudWatch, Amazon RDS, load balancing, auto scaling, certificate management, CloudFront, and identity integrations.
Built continuous delivery pipelines and supported REST-based microservices deployments across Demo, Test, Pentest, Training, CTDEV, Sandbox, UAT, and PROD environments.
Used CloudFormation and PowerShell scripting to provision and manage cloud resources in a repeatable and auditable manner.
Designed monitoring architecture to collect application, infrastructure, and platform metrics using the ELK stack.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
